name: Metorik
description:
Metorik gives Claude the full picture of your Shopify or WooCommerce store — not just orders and revenue, but true profit, costs, and the business intelligence behind them.

Shopify and Woo only know what happens inside their own four walls. Metorik joins everything else: ad spend from Google, Meta, TikTok and more, transaction fees, shipping costs, COGS, and refunds. So when you ask Claude a question, it's answering from a complete, reliable picture of your business — real margins, not gross revenue.

Ask things like:
• "What was my actual profit last month after ad spend and fees?"
• "Which products look great on revenue but are quietly losing money?"
• "Why is my refund rate spiking in Germany? Break it down by SKU."
• "What's the LTV of customers acquired through Meta vs Google?"
• "How are we tracking against this month's sales goal?"

Then keep going. Refine, drill in, change angle, compare timeframes — it's a conversation, not a report. What you'd get from an analyst, minus the wait.

Everything is pulled live from your Metorik data: sales, profit, costs, customers, cohorts, products, subscriptions, ad performance, goals, and forecasts. The numbers are the same ones that power your Metorik reports — no AI guesswork.

Access is read-only, nothing you ask is used to train AI models, and it runs on the same infrastructure that's powered reporting for 10,000+ Shopify and WooCommerce stores since 2016. Got multiple stores? Ask cross-store questions in a single conversation.

Included on every Metorik plan, including the free 30-day trial.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Metorik to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Metorik to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.metorik.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Metorik MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metorik provides these MCP tools: get_engage_campaigns, get_goals, get_store_catalog, get_store_catalog_by_date, get_store_report, get_store_totals, list_store_metadata, list_store_objects, list_stores, search_store, and build_segment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Metorik?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Metorik in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Metorik requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Metorik is developed by Metorik. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
